scene: The brass birdcage lift shoots upward, opening onto the rooftop transit deck.
picture: A flat side view of the breezy hotel rooftop deck. On the far left, a purple bowling-ball monorail carriage waits with its hatch open. Beside it stands the player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates. At centre, a glowing neon escalator ascends skyward. On the right, a steaming noodle-cart monorail vehicle sits on rails.
